title: Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock
title_zh: Open Dev Society 出品的 OpenStock

paragraphs.en: OpenStock is an open-source alternative to expensive market platforms. Track real-time prices, set personalized alerts, and explore detailed company insights — built openly, for everyone, forever free.
paragraphs.zh: OpenStock 是昂贵市场平台的开源替代品。 追踪实时价格、设置个性化提醒、探索详细的公司洞察——以开放方式构建，为所有人服务，永久免费。

paragraphs.en: Markets, minus the paywall. OpenStock is a free, open-source alternative to expensive market platforms: track prices, watch the whole market and dig into company insights. Use it at openstock-ods.vercel.app , or run your own copy with every feature.
paragraphs.zh: 市场，无需付费墙。 OpenStock 是昂贵市场平台的免费开源替代品：追踪价格，观察整个市场，并深入了解公司洞察。 你可以在 openstock-ods.vercel.app 上使用它，或者运行你自己的副本并使用所有功能。

paragraphs.en: You need Node.js 22 LTS, a MongoDB database (a free Atlas cluster, or the Docker setup ) and a free Finnhub key.
paragraphs.zh: 你需要 Node.js 22 LTS、一个 MongoDB 数据库（免费的 Atlas 集群，或 Docker 设置）以及一个免费的 Finnhub 密钥。

paragraphs.en: git clone https://github.com/Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock.git cd OpenStock npm ci cp .env.example .env # fill in MONGODB_URI, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and FINNHUB_API_KEY node scripts/check-env.mjs # checks your .env npm run test:db # checks the MongoDB connection npm run dev # http://localhost:3000 Welcome emails, price alerts and the weekly digest run as Inngest jobs. Locally, start Inngest's dev server alongside the app: npx inngest-cli@latest dev .
paragraphs.zh: git clone https://github.com/Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock.git cd OpenStock npm ci cp .env.example .env # 填写 MONGODB_URI、BETTER_AUTH_SECRET 和 FINNHUB_API_KEY node scripts/check-env.mjs # 检查你的 .env npm run test:db # 检查 MongoDB 连接 npm run dev # http://localhost:3000 欢迎邮件、价格提醒和每周摘要作为 Inngest 任务运行。 在本地， alongside 应用程序启动 Inngest 的开发服务器： npx inngest-cli@latest dev .

sents.en: Locally, start Inngest's dev server alongside the app: npx inngest-cli@latest dev .
sents.zh: 在本地， alongside 应用程序启动 Inngest 的开发服务器： npx inngest-cli@latest dev .

paragraphs.en: For production: npm run build && npm start .
paragraphs.zh: 生产环境：npm run build && npm start .

paragraphs.en: Every variable is listed with comments in .env.example . The ones that matter:

paragraphs.en: NEXT_PUBLIC_FINNHUB_API_KEY still works as a name for the Finnhub key. No key is ever sent to the browser.
paragraphs.zh: NEXT_PUBLIC_FINNHUB_API_KEY 仍然可以作为 Finnhub 密钥的名称。 任何密钥都不会被发送到浏览器。

paragraphs.en: Runs OpenStock and MongoDB together. MongoDB is only reachable inside the Docker network; it isn't published on your machine.
paragraphs.zh: 同时运行 OpenStock 和 MongoDB。 MongoDB 仅在 Docker 网络内可访问；它不会发布到你的机器上。

sents.en: Runs OpenStock and MongoDB together.
sents.zh: 同时运行 OpenStock 和 MongoDB。

sents.en: MongoDB is only reachable inside the Docker network; it isn't published on your machine.
sents.zh: MongoDB 仅在 Docker 网络内可访问；它不会发布到你的机器上。

paragraphs.en: MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD = change-me MONGODB_URI = mongodb://root:change-me@mongodb:27017/openstock?authSource=admin Start it: docker compose up -d --build Open http://localhost:3000 The image build needs no secrets: every variable is read when the container starts, except NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE , which Compose passes to the build from .env . Data lives in the mongo-data volume, and the MongoDB password is only applied when that volume is first created.
paragraphs.zh: MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD = change-me MONGODB_URI = mongodb://root:change-me@mongodb:27017/openstock?authSource=admin 启动它：docker compose up -d --build 打开 http://localhost:3000 镜像构建无需任何密钥：每个变量都是在容器启动时读取的，唯有 NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE 例外，它由 Compose 在构建时从 .env 传入。 数据存放在 mongo-data 卷中，而 MongoDB 密码只在该卷首次创建时生效。

sents.en: MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD = change-me MONGODB_URI = mongodb://root:change-me@mongodb:27017/openstock?authSource=admin Start it: docker compose up -d --build Open http://localhost:3000 The image build needs no secrets: every variable is read when the container starts, except NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE , which Compose passes to the build from .env .

paragraphs.en: Every push to main publishes ghcr.io/open-dev-society/openstock for amd64 and arm64, tagged latest , sha-<commit> , and a version for each release (for example 2026.10.18 ). To use it, replace build: under openstock in docker-compose.yml with:
paragraphs.zh: 每次向 main 推送都会发布 ghcr.io/open-dev-society/openstock，支持 amd64 和 arm64 架构，标签包括 latest、sha-<commit>，以及每个发行版本对应的版本号（例如 2026.10.18）。 要使用它，请将 docker-compose.yml 中 openstock 下的 build: 替换为：

paragraphs.en: image : ghcr.io/open-dev-society/openstock:latest then run docker compose pull && docker compose up -d . The prebuilt image runs in cached mode; build it yourself for realtime.
paragraphs.zh: 镜像：ghcr.io/open-dev-society/openstock:latest，然后运行 docker compose pull && docker compose up -d 。 预构建的镜像以缓存模式运行；如需实时模式，请自行构建。

sents.zh: 镜像：ghcr.io/open-dev-society/openstock:latest，然后运行 docker compose pull && docker compose up -d 。

sents.en: The prebuilt image runs in cached mode; build it yourself for realtime.
sents.zh: 预构建的镜像以缓存模式运行；如需实时模式，请自行构建。

paragraphs.en: OpenStock ships a railway.json that builds the Dockerfile , checks health on /sign-in and restarts on failure. The template above sets everything up; to do it by hand:
paragraphs.zh: OpenStock 附带一个 railway.json，它会构建 Dockerfile、在 /sign-in 上进行健康检查，并在失败时重启。 上面的模板已完成所有配置；若要手动操作：

sents.en: OpenStock ships a railway.json that builds the Dockerfile , checks health on /sign-in and restarts on failure.
sents.zh: OpenStock 附带一个 railway.json，它会构建 Dockerfile、在 /sign-in 上进行健康检查，并在失败时重启。

sents.en: The template above sets everything up; to do it by hand:
sents.zh: 上面的模板已完成所有配置；若要手动操作：

paragraphs.en: MONGODB_URI = ${ {MongoDB.MONGO_URL } } BETTER_AUTH_SECRET = ${ {secret(32) } } BETTER_AUTH_URL = https:// ${ {RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN } } FINNHUB_API_KEY = your_finnhub_key GEMINI_API_KEY = your_gemini_api_key INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY = your_inngest_signing_key INNGEST_EVENT_KEY = your_inngest_event_key NODEMAILER_EMAIL = youraddress@gmail.com NODEMAILER_PASSWORD = your_gmail_app_password Under Settings → Networking , generate a public domain and redeploy. For background jobs, add your Railway domain as an app in the Inngest dashboard , pointing to https://<your-domain>/api/inngest . To turn on realtime mode, also set NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE=realtime ; Railway passes it to the build.
paragraphs.zh: MONGODB_URI = ${ {MongoDB.MONGO_URL } } BETTER_AUTH_SECRET = ${ {secret(32) } } BETTER_AUTH_URL = https:// ${ {RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN } } FINNHUB_API_KEY = your_finnhub_key GEMINI_API_KEY = your_gemini_api_key INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY = your_inngest_signing_key INNGEST_EVENT_KEY = your_inngest_event_key NODEMAILER_EMAIL = youraddress@gmail.com NODEMAILER_PASSWORD = your_gmail_app_password 在 Settings → Networking 下，生成一个公共域名并重新部署。 对于后台任务，请在 Inngest 控制面板中将你的 Railway 域名添加为一个应用，指向 https://<your-domain>/api/inngest 。 要开启实时模式，还需设置 NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE=realtime ；Railway 会将其传递给构建过程。

sents.en: MONGODB_URI = ${ {MongoDB.MONGO_URL } } BETTER_AUTH_SECRET = ${ {secret(32) } } BETTER_AUTH_URL = https:// ${ {RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN } } FINNHUB_API_KEY = your_finnhub_key GEMINI_API_KEY = your_gemini_api_key INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY = your_inngest_signing_key INNGEST_EVENT_KEY = your_inngest_event_key NODEMAILER_EMAIL = youraddress@gmail.com NODEMAILER_PASSWORD = your_gmail_app_password Under Settings → Networking , generate a public domain and redeploy.

sents.en: For background jobs, add your Railway domain as an app in the Inngest dashboard , pointing to https://<your-domain>/api/inngest .
sents.zh: 对于后台任务，请在 Inngest 控制面板中将你的 Railway 域名添加为一个应用，指向 https://<your-domain>/api/inngest 。

sents.en: To turn on realtime mode, also set NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE=realtime ; Railway passes it to the build.
sents.zh: 要开启实时模式，还需设置 NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE=realtime ；Railway 会将其传递给构建过程。

paragraphs.en: Import the repository, set the variables above for Production, and connect Inngest (its Vercel integration sets both keys). vercel.json pins functions to Mumbai ( bom1 ), next to the hosted database; change it to the region nearest yours.
paragraphs.zh: 导入代码仓库，为生产环境设置上述变量，并连接 Inngest（其 Vercel 集成会自动设置这两个密钥）。vercel.json 将函数固定在孟买（bom1），与托管数据库相邻；请将其更改为距离你最近的区域。

sents.en: Responses are cached and shared (for an hour, or 15 seconds in realtime mode), with timeouts and a key pool, so a slow upstream never hangs a page.
sents.zh: 响应会被缓存并共享（缓存一小时，实时模式下为 15 秒），并配有超时机制和密钥池，因此上游响应缓慢也不会导致页面卡住。

paragraphs.en: TradingView : the chart, heatmap, financials, technicals and profile widgets.
paragraphs.zh: TradingView：图表、热力图、财务、技术指标和简介小部件。

paragraphs.en: Better Auth with MongoDB : accounts and sessions. Pages and server actions check the session on the server; the middleware only redirects signed-out visitors.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 MongoDB 的 Better Auth：账户与会话。 页面和服务器操作会在服务器端检查会话；中间件仅重定向未登录的访问者。

paragraphs.en: Email : Nodemailer (Gmail) sends welcome, alert and password-reset emails; Kit sends the weekly digest.

paragraphs.en: Every merged pull request, and every issue that leads to a fix, is credited on the changelog and below. Be kind, guide beginners, no gatekeeping: that's the Open Dev Society way. Participation is covered by the Code of Conduct .

paragraphs.en: OpenStock is and will remain free and open for everyone. It's licensed under AGPL-3.0 : if you modify, redistribute or deploy it (including as a web service), you must release your source code under the same license and credit the original authors.
paragraphs.zh: OpenStock 现在免费开放，未来也将始终对所有人免费开放。 它采用 AGPL-3.0 许可证授权：如果你修改、再分发或部署它（包括作为网络服务部署），你必须以相同的许可证发布你的源代码，并注明原作者。

paragraphs.en: We live in a world where knowledge is hidden behind paywalls. Where tools are locked in subscriptions. Where information is twisted by bias. Where newcomers are told they’re not “good enough” to build.
paragraphs.zh: 我们生活在一个知识被付费墙阻挡的世界。 一个工具被订阅锁定的世界。 一个信息被偏见扭曲的世界。 一个新手被告知自己“不够格”去构建的世界。

paragraphs.en: Built openly, for everyone, forever free. © Open Dev Society.
paragraphs.zh: 开放构建，面向所有人，永久免费。© Open Dev Society.

paragraphs.en: OpenStock is free, open source and used by 13,000+ registered people . Keeping it that way costs money every month: hosting, the database, market data keys, AI and email, and the hours that go into reviewing pull requests and shipping fixes.
paragraphs.zh: OpenStock 是免费、开源的，已有超过 13,000 名注册用户在使用。 保持这样的运营每个月都要花钱：主机托管、数据库、市场数据密钥、AI 和邮件服务，以及审查拉取请求和发布修复所投入的时间。
